name: wpr-scrcpy
description: WprScrcpy GUI and ADB Controller with Wi-Fi Debugging QR Code and Terminal

scripts.build: npx electron-packager . WprScrcpy --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=smartphone.ico --overwrite --out=dist --app-version=3.2.0 --ignore="(\.git|dist|scratch|get_scrcpy_bounds\.cs|get_scrcpy_bounds\.ps1|create_shortcut\.ps1|Chay_AeroScrcpy\.bat|\.zip|\.rar)" && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File create_shortcut.ps1
